meta.name: vision
meta.description: Query images with a local Ollama vision model without loading the image into the main agent context. Use when you need to describe a screenshot, check whether rendered content is present, detect overlapping elements, or ask any visual question about a PNG/JPEG/WebP file. Requires Ollama running locally with the Gemma 4 multimodal model (`gemma4` on Ollama). Script: .agents/skills/vision/scripts/ask.py. Trigger phrases: "describe image", "what does this screenshot show", "does the canvas contain content", "check screenshot visually", "look at this image", "any overlapping elements", "vision query".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以用本地 Ollama 上的 Gemma 4 模型回答关于图片的问题，比如描述截图、检查内容或检测重叠元素。图片不会上传到主对话。
howto.when: 当你提到“describe image”、“look at this image”等触发词，或要求描述截图、检查渲染内容、检测重叠元素时触发。需要本地运行 Ollama 并安装 Gemma 4 模型。

say.note: Claude 会检查图片中是否有可见内容。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can answer questions about images using a local Ollama Gemma 4 model, such as describing screenshots, checking content, or detecting overlapping elements. Images are not uploaded to the main conversation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention trigger phrases like "describe image", "look at this image", or ask to describe a screenshot, check rendered content, or detect overlapping elements. Requires Ollama running locally with Gemma 4 installed.

say_en.note: Claude will use the local model to describe the image.

say_en.text: does this canvas contain any content?
say_en.note: Claude will check if the image has visible content.

say_en.text: are there overlapping elements in this image?
say_en.note: Claude will detect overlapping elements in the image.
